lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters organized into approximately five visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The centroids follow a semi-regular grid pattern with higher spatial density in the dorsal-lateral region compared to the ventral-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a rectangular coordinate-like grid across the primary flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from light pixels on the dorsal-facing surface to shadow-tone pixels on the ventral-facing surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin surface contains a high density of small, high-luminance blobs, with the highest concentration occurring near the leading edge and distal tip.
